ascension.bloodline.azure_thunder_dragon: A rare draconic inheritance in which storm and deep water mingle in the blood.
ascension.bloodline.barbarian.desc: Descendants of the untamed tribes beyond the sect lands, their bodies honed by hardship into raw, unyielding power
ascension.bloodline.barbarian.name: Barbarian
ascension.bloodline.beastkin.desc: Mortals born with a trace of ancient spirit beast blood in their veins, granting fierce vitality and primal instinct
ascension.bloodline.beastkin.name: Beastkin
ascension.bloodline.black_iron_ant.desc: A low-grade demonic insect lineage descended from black-iron ants, prized for dense flesh and strength far beyond their size.
ascension.bloodline.black_iron_ant.name: Black-Iron Ant Bloodline
A tiger lineage descended from beasts that prowled ancient celestial battlefields, bringing ruin to all in their way.
ascension.bloodline.deep_spring_spirit.d: A spirit-blooded lineage descended from beings born in old mountain springs. Its qi is cool, patient, and difficult to exhaust.
ascension.bloodline.dreamless_sovereign_: An ancient sovereign-turtle lineage whose spirit rests in absolute silence.
ascension.bloodline.eighteen_winged_thre: An impossible solar-crow lineage bearing eighteen crystalline wings and three radiant legs. Its transparent blood refracts heavenly fire into searing light, as though a fragment of the true sun had learned to fly.
ascension.bloodline.ember_spirit.desc: A minor lineage altered by generations spent beside small fire spirits. Its qi runs warm and answers readily to flame.
ascension.bloodline.ember_spirit.name: Ember Spirit Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.eternal_tribulation_: An impossible draconic inheritance said to descend from an ancestral dragon that tempered itself beneath heavenly tribulation before the laws of the world had fully settled. Lightning strengthened its blood, chaos fed its marrow, and every drop contains an immeasurable tyranny.
ascension.bloodline.falling_star.desc: A mortal lineage born of those living within meteor fields.
ascension.bloodline.falling_star.name: Falling Star Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.formless_river_drago: A river-dragon lineage whose blood refuses a fixed shape.
ascension.bloodline.frostkin.desc: Descendants of the tribes that endured the frozen wastes for generations, their blood carries an innate resistance to the cold and a body built to endure
ascension.bloodline.frostkin.name: Frostkin
ascension.bloodline.golden_maned_lion.de: A proud spirit-beast lineage whose warm yang blood strengthens the body and gives the voice a natural resonance with qi.
ascension.bloodline.golden_silkworm.desc: A rare gu lineage descended from golden silkworms raised on medicinal poisons. Its qi is dense and venomous, and its threads harden like metal.
ascension.bloodline.golden_silkworm.name: Golden Silkworm Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.human.desc: The most common and adaptable of mortal bloodlines, balanced in body and spirit
ascension.bloodline.human.name: Human
ascension.bloodline.jade_cicada.desc: A spirit-insect lineage known for shedding its shell as it matures.
ascension.bloodline.jade_cicada.name: Jade Cicada Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.moon_white_crane.des: A spirit-beast lineage descended from glimmering cranes that nest above moonlit cloud seas.
ascension.bloodline.moonveil_fox.desc: A spirit-beast lineage carrying the blood of moon foxes.
ascension.bloodline.moonveil_fox.name: Moonveil Fox Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.purple_star_qilin.de: An auspicious qilin lineage tied to the purple sovereign star.
ascension.bloodline.scalekin.desc: Descendants of the deep-water jiao, their skin bears faint scales and their bodies endure where lesser mortals would drown
ascension.bloodline.scalekin.name: Scalekin
ascension.bloodline.stargazing_virtuous_: A mythical roc lineage said to navigate by the sovereign stars rather than the horizon. Auspicious winds gather beneath its wings, causing swirls in fate with each beat.
A phoenix lineage whose blood burns with a clear solar flame. Wounds close beneath its heat, exhausted qi rekindles readily, and each rise in purity strengthens the faint cycle of death and renewal hidden within the blood.
ascension.bloodline.verdant_flame_spirit: A rare lineage carrying the nature of a living green flame that feeds upon spiritual herbs. Its fire burns cleanly and is highly prized by refiners.
ascension.bloodline.verdantblood.desc: A mortal lineage steeped in old forest qi, whose blood recovers stubbornly and takes to wood cultivation with ease.
ascension.bloodline.verdantblood.name: Verdantblood
ascension.bloodline.virtuous_freedom_gra: A transcendent immortal lineage said to have cast off every worldly shackle without abandoning virtue.
ascension.bloodline.void_devouring_kunpe: A lineage carrying a trace of the Kunpeng, the vast spirit beast said to cross sea and sky in a single transformation. Its blood hungers for distance itself, causing storms of wind and space with every beat.
ascension.bloodline.white_tiger.desc: A rare lineage carrying a trace of the White Tiger, sacred beast of the western heavens.
ascension.bloodline.white_tiger.name: White Tiger Bloodline
ascension.bloodline.wilderness_stalker_d: A divine dragon-turtle lineage born in untamed continents beyond known lands. Its presence sinks into earth and ancient growth, masking immense strength beneath patience, erupting the moment it strikes.
ascension.bloodline.wind_chasing_leopard: A minor spirit-beast lineage descended from mountain leopards that hunt along windy ridges.
ascension.herb.blood_lingzhi_mushroom.de: A crimson Lingzhi that devoured the blood from dead Ghast rending it nothing but bones.
ascension.herb.fire_ginseng.description: A blazing ginseng root that carries a distinct fiery nature.
ascension.herb.ginseng.description: A medicinal root prized for the strength it gathers with age.
ascension.herb.heavenly_thunder_peach.de: A rare peach whose flesh ripens slowly until storms and thunder drive its spiritual nature awake.
ascension.herb.jade_dew_grass.descriptio: A delicate herb whose leaves gather cool beads of dew.
ascension.herb.lingzhi_mushroom.descript: A medicinal fungus that grows from old wood.
ascension.herb.moonwell_jade_lotus.descr: A pale jade lotus nourished by water Qi, rain, and the cold radiance of the night sky.
ascension.herb.nine_sun_fire_root.descri: A sun-fed root that thrives in scorching lands and holds heat within its flesh.
ascension.herb.snow_ginseng.description: A frozen ginseng root adapted to cold and snowy lands.
ascension.mob_cultivation.presence: Spiritual Qi shifts through the air Something unnerving is nearby

ascension.path.elemental.wind.name: Wind
ascension.path.elemental.wood.desc: cultivate the growth and resilience of living green
ascension.path.elemental.wood.name: Wood
ascension.path.elemental.yang.desc: cultivate the active, radiant, and assertive half of existence

ascension.path.elemental.yin.desc: cultivate the receptive, cold, and hidden half of existence

ascension.path.foundation.body.desc: temper the flesh until it rivals iron and stone
ascension.path.foundation.body.name: Body
ascension.path.foundation.essence.desc: cultivate the essence that permeates existence
ascension.path.foundation.essence.name: Essence
ascension.path.foundation.soul.desc: awaken the spirit within and forge it into an unyielding will
ascension.path.foundation.soul.name: Soul
ascension.path.weapon.axe.desc: cultivate the heavy, splitting momentum of the axe
ascension.path.weapon.axe.name: Axe
ascension.path.weapon.blade.desc: cultivate the swift, cleaving edge of the single-edged blade
ascension.path.weapon.blade.name: Blade
ascension.path.weapon.bow.desc: cultivate the patience and precision of the drawn string
ascension.path.weapon.bow.name: Bow
ascension.path.weapon.fan.desc: cultivate the elegant, deceptive art of the folding fan
ascension.path.weapon.fan.name: Fan
ascension.path.weapon.fist.desc: cultivate the body and will behind an unarmed strike
ascension.path.weapon.fist.name: Fist
ascension.path.weapon.halberd.desc: cultivate the sweeping reach of blade and pole combined
ascension.path.weapon.halberd.name: Halberd
ascension.path.weapon.hammer.desc: cultivate the earth-shaking force of the war hammer
ascension.path.weapon.hammer.name: Hammer
ascension.path.weapon.knife.desc: cultivate the speed and precision of close-quarter steel
ascension.path.weapon.knife.name: Knife
ascension.path.weapon.mace.desc: cultivate the raw crushing weight of blunt force
ascension.path.weapon.mace.name: Mace
ascension.path.weapon.shield.desc: cultivate the unmoving resolve of one who stands between
ascension.path.weapon.shield.name: Shield
ascension.path.weapon.spear.desc: cultivate the reach and precision of the thrusting spear
ascension.path.weapon.spear.name: Spear
ascension.path.weapon.staff.desc: cultivate the flowing, versatile forms of the long staff
ascension.path.weapon.staff.name: Staff
ascension.path.weapon.sword.name: Sword
ascension.path.weapon.umbrella.desc: cultivate the deceptive grace of the warding canopy, sheltering blow and blade alike
ascension.path.weapon.umbrella.name: Umbrella
ascension.path.weapon.whip.desc: cultivate the flexible, coiling strikes of the whip
ascension.path.weapon.whip.name: Whip
ascension.physique.azure_ashura_divine_g: A divine war-form whose blood moves like an azure tide through a resilient frame. Water qi tempers its violence, blood qi feeds its recovery, and every fist carries the momentum of a general.
ascension.physique.brittle_bone_body.des: Bones are fragile and prone to breaking under stress, severely limiting physical combat and body cultivation. Those born with this physique can only cultivate Soul.
ascension.physique.cold_spring_dantian.d: The dantian resembles a clear, cold spring. Water qi settles easily within it, while colder currents can condense without disrupting circulation.
A body afflicted by a powerful curse that weakens normal cultivation and attracts misfortune. The Curse may only be mitigated with Demonic Techniques.
ascension.physique.dampened_fire_body_ph: A body with a natural dampness that extinguishes fire, making fire techniques unusable.
ascension.physique.ember_touched_meridia: The meridians remain naturally warm, allowing fire qi to circulate with less strain and making lesser flame spirits easier to accommodate.
ascension.physique.ethereal_grandmist_co: A connate soul constitution filled with pale grandmist. Starlight sinks into the mist while gravity gathers around the spirit like a tide, making vast and weighty soul arts simple to cultivate.
ascension.physique.fire_spirit_body_unst: Strong fire affinity but the fire energy is volatile and hard to control, often burning the user from within.
ascension.physique.firefly_spirit_eyes.d: Faint lights gather behind the pupils, making wandering spiritual qi easier to perceive and follow.
ascension.physique.five_element_spirit_v: An unusually balanced vessel whose essence can nourish spirits of wood, fire, earth, metal, and water without strongly rejecting any one of them.
ascension.physique.five_elements_imbalan: The five elements within the body are in chaos, causing cultivation instability and frequent qi deviations. Those who persevere with this may be surprised.
ascension.physique.frostbitten_vein_body: Veins are permanently frostbitten, causing pain when qi circulates and reducing overall flow.
ascension.physique.gale_cheetah_meridian: Broad, springing meridians carry qi cleanly through the legs and hips.
ascension.physique.golden_sun_heart.desc: A dense knot of yang qi rests around the heart, emblazing your blood.
ascension.physique.golden_sun_heart.name: Golden Sun Heart
ascension.physique.great_sun_sacred_body: A constitution whose blood, marrow, and meridians carry the heat of a rising sun. Yang qi gathers without urging, cold struggle to take root, and every circulation tempers the body as though beneath blistering light.
ascension.physique.heavenly_river_dantia: The dantian forms a broad, tranquil sea where star qi drifts in a slow current.
ascension.physique.heavy_bone_physique.d: Bones are abnormally heavy, making the user slow and lumbering, though slightly resistant to physical force. Those who cultivate Body with this physique will achieve success.
ascension.physique.hundred_venom_dantian: The dantian tolerates poisonous and impure qi that would cripple ordinary cultivators, refining it without easily fouling the meridians.
ascension.physique.ice_soul_body_flawed_: Strong ice affinity but the cold energy damages the body over time, causing frostbite and organ decay.
ascension.physique.iron_ant_bones.desc: The bones are compact and dark, bearing weight with ease and lending the limbs significant force.
ascension.physique.iron_ant_bones.name: Iron Ant Bones
ascension.physique.iron_blossom_body.des: A body as unyielding as stone yet still capable of growth, standing firm behind a shield like a flower rooted in bedrock.
ascension.physique.jade_cocoon_body.desc: When qi is circulated inward, the flesh settles into a cocoon-like state that promotes recovery.
ascension.physique.jade_cocoon_body.name: Jade Cocoon Body
ascension.physique.jade_furnace.desc: The flesh tempers qi like a living furnace, drawing fire through the body and tempering them like volcanic channels.
ascension.physique.jade_furnace.name: Jade Furnace Physique
ascension.physique.lion_roar_chest.desc: The chest and lungs form a deep resonant chamber. Breath carries qi with force, giving sound cultivation a firm foundation.
ascension.physique.lion_roar_chest.name: Lion-Roar Chest
ascension.physique.lunar_dream_eyes.desc: Eyes born beneath an unachievable moon perceive the seam between waking thought and dream.
ascension.physique.lunar_dream_eyes.name: Lunar Dream Eyes
ascension.physique.mantis_blade.desc: The tendons and forearms naturally align with short cutting motions, making blade arts unnervingly quick and precise.
ascension.physique.mantis_blade.name: Mantis Blade Physique
ascension.physique.miasma_lungs_body_phy: Lungs are filled with miasma, making breathing difficult and qi circulation weak and tainted.
ascension.physique.moonjade_marrow.desc: The marrow carries a cool jade lustre.
ascension.physique.moonjade_marrow.name: Moonjade Marrow
ascension.physique.nine_heavens_myriad_w: An unimaginable physique said to mirror the structure of the heavens themselves. Qi turns through flesh, marrow, and acupoints in eonic cycles, as though every point of the body holds the shadow of a world. Spatio-temporal rivers nourish the body, flooding the hidden shadows and letting them flourish. Laws and Daos seek out the worlds within the folds of this body, fighting for acceptance.
Nine Heavens Myriad Worlds Dao Body
ascension.physique.nine_life_demon_cat_b: A rare demon-cat constitution whose souls clings stubbornly to life.
ascension.physique.primordial_chaos_dao_: A constitution born with an essence sea that accepts both chaos and order. Opposing forces settle within the same circulation without immediate collapse, while space, time, and fate find unusually little resistance within its meridians.
ascension.physique.seven_star_bones.desc: Seven points of star qi are sealed within the skeleton, tempering the bones over time.
ascension.physique.seven_star_bones.name: Seven-Star Bones
Dark qi settles naturally within meridians running through the limbs.
ascension.physique.shallow_core_body_phy: The dantian is shallow and cannot hold much qi, severely limiting combat endurance.
ascension.physique.soul_sovereignty_revo: Three sovereign thrones revolve within the soul, each presiding over thought, dreams, and the pull of fate. The body is merely their heavenly court; the spirit is the divine kingdom, and lesser souls struggle to shake its rule.
ascension.physique.spirit_furnace_dantia: A furnace-like chamber forms within the dantian, giving living flame qi a place to settle and be nurtured without scorching its host.
ascension.physique.starlit_meridians.des: Fine meridians branch close to the skin, gathering faint star qi more readily than ordinary channels.
ascension.physique.sword_body_flawed_phy: Natural affinity for swords but with a flaw that causes instability in the user's qi and sword intent.
ascension.physique.sword_bone.desc: Your bones are forged into blades, letting out a hum as they resonate with your blade
ascension.physique.sword_bone.name: Sword Bone
ascension.physique.thirty_three_divines_: Thirty-three impossible vessel meridians overlap the ordinary channels, each carrying a different current through the essence sea. Chaos rushes between them without tearing the body apart, while divine light threads the disorder into patterns of sheer purity.
Thirty Three Divines Chaotic Vessel Meridians
ascension.physique.thousand_edge_meridia: Meridians branch through the limbs like sharpened blades, carrying metal qi cleanly into swords, sabres, and knives.
ascension.physique.thunder_body_unstable: Lightning affinity but the electricity damages the body's meridians and nerves with each use.
Fine channels run through the limbs like branching lightning, letting violent thunder qi pass through flesh with unusual speed.
ascension.physique.tiger_marrow.desc: The marrow is dense and vigorous, continually nourishing the bones and lending the body a tiger's force.
ascension.physique.tiger_marrow.name: Tiger Marrow
ascension.physique.trembling_earth_body_: Earth affinity but the user's body trembles uncontrollably, making fine movements and precise techniques difficult. The tremors also destabilize the ground around them.
ascension.physique.weak_spirit_body_phys: A body with weak spiritual roots, making it difficult to absorb and cultivate qi. Progress is excruciatingly slow.
ascension.skill.aquila_crossing.desc: Follow a projected celestial line and cross rapidly toward the point held in your sight
ascension.skill.aquila_crossing.name: Aquila Crossing
ascension.skill.bleeding_locust_swarm.de: Seed a victim with short-lived locust qi that deals light damage and rarely leaps to nearby creatures.
ascension.skill.body_beyond_mortal_limit: A transcendent frame multiplies the body's core qualities while hardening it against damage and stagger.
ascension.skill.bone_resonance_strike.de: Set the skeleton ringing with gathered body qi and discharge that resonance through a compact blow.
ascension.skill.burning_bone_tempering.d: Draw fire through the marrow and let its heat temper the skeleton while body cultivation advances.
ascension.skill.celestial_constellation_: Circulate Soul through Star and Bow, drawing seven points of the inner night sky into a single spiritual map
ascension.skill.cinder_bones.desc: Fire-tempered bones endure impact with greater stubbornness and resist being staggered.
ascension.skill.cinder_bones.name: Cinder Bones
ascension.skill.cloud_leaping_step.desc: Carry the principles of lightness into the air, bursting along the direction of your gaze.
ascension.skill.cloud_leaping_step.name: Cloud-Leaping Step
ascension.skill.divine_sense.desc: Release a pulse of spiritual perception that reveals nearby beings and items through obstacles.
ascension.skill.divine_sense.name: Divine Sense
Hook the hand like a talon and drive a short tearing palm through the opponent's guard.
ascension.skill.featherstep.desc: Shift the body's weight in an instant and skim rapidly across the ground.
ascension.skill.featherstep.name: Featherstep
ascension.skill.fourfold_dharma_circulat: Cycle Soul, Life, Order, and Fist through one disciplined circuit, strengthening the foundation of the guardian path
ascension.skill.frostbound_stillness.des: Gather cold spiritual stillness before releasing it across nearby creatures, building frost and imposing Frozen Form.
ascension.skill.golden_bell_of_living_la: Manifest a durable Golden Bell that absorbs incoming damage.
ascension.skill.grasping_sand_palm.desc: Drive a compact palm through the space ahead, catching several nearby opponents in the same crushing motion.
ascension.skill.grasping_sand_palm.name: Grasping Sand Palm
ascension.skill.heaven_breaking_fist.des: Hold the whole body behind one fist, charge its force, and release a blow whose power rises with the gathered moment.
ascension.skill.heaven_grinding_slaughte: Charge the completed wheel and release it through the surrounding space, crushing nearby enemies beneath your revolutions.
ascension.skill.hooked_talon_grip.desc: Conditioned fingers and wrists lend greater force to empty-hand and fist-weapon strikes.
ascension.skill.hooked_talon_grip.name: Hooked Talon Grip
ascension.skill.hound_star_pursuit.desc: Fix a Hound-Star mark upon a quarry; repeated marks make evasive movement increasingly demanding
ascension.skill.hound_star_pursuit.name: Canis Major: Hound-Star Pursuit
ascension.skill.imperial_fifth_stance.de: Brace for a moment and form a thin defensive screen barely strong enough to blunt a clean hit.
ascension.skill.imperial_first_stance.de: A disciplined opening cut taught to every recruit; quick, cheap, and deliberately unremarkable.
ascension.skill.imperial_fourth_stance.d: Compress the sword line into a narrow thrust patterned after an infantry spearhead.
ascension.skill.imperial_second_stance.d: Advance behind the blade before releasing a short, cautious cut.
Commit to the art's strongest finishing thrust, formidable only by ordinary mortal standards.
ascension.skill.imperial_sixth_stance.de: Turn through a compact circular cut designed for enemies pressing from several sides.
ascension.skill.imperial_third_stance.de: A broad waist-high sweep intended to clear space around a marching standard.
ascension.skill.iron_breaking_fist.desc: Commit the tempered arm to a heavy forward punch capable of knocking an opponent off balance.
ascension.skill.iron_breaking_fist.name: Iron-Breaking Fist
ascension.skill.iron_fist_tempering.desc: Circulate body qi through hand, wrist, and forearm, tempering the striking frame through repeated pressure.
ascension.skill.iron_fist_tempering.name: Iron Fist Tempering
ascension.skill.marrow_flame_fist.desc: Drive heat from the marrow into a close-range strike that scorches the target from the point of impact.
ascension.skill.marrow_flame_fist.name: Marrow-Flame Fist
ascension.skill.martial_transcendence_vo: Run body qi through the major muscle groups to refine the mortal frame without wasting motion.
Force body qi through bone and tendon in a harsher circuit, reforging the frame established by the first volume.
Circulate body qi through the entire frame as one system, refining flesh and spirit toward a genuinely transcendent body.
ascension.skill.mountain_receives_strike: Brace every joint into one structure and raise a short-lived guard whose durability follows your Vitality.
ascension.skill.nine_paths_circulation.d: Guide essence through repeated internal routes, polishing the same foundation from a different angle with every cycle.
ascension.skill.nine_revolutions_circula: Circulates essence through nine meridian routes, grinding into fuel for the forming Slaughter Wheel.
ascension.skill.ninefold_carnage_circuit: Pins a revolving slaughter circuit to the ground, grinding any enemies caught within it.
ascension.skill.one_breath_draw.desc: Release sword, breath, and forward momentum in one clean cut before returning to stillness.
ascension.skill.one_breath_draw.name: One-Breath Draw
ascension.skill.ordered_vajra_body.desc: Forge body and spirit into a disciplined Vajra, increasing Vitality, Spirit, and Strength
ascension.skill.ordered_vajra_body.name: Ordered Vajra Body
ascension.skill.orions_celestial_draw.de: Strengthen ranged projectiles with Agility and Spirit, guiding them toward targets marked by Hound-Star Pursuit
ascension.skill.plum_blossom_breathing.d: The first breathing method taught at Mount Hua, circulating qi until it flows naturally into the sword, letting sword and essence grow together as one
ascension.skill.refined_mortal_frame.des: The first stage of transcendence leaves flesh and musculature denser, stronger, and harder to exhaust.
ascension.skill.reforged_mortal_frame.de: The second stage of transcendence binds strength, endurance, and speed into a sturdier whole.
ascension.skill.revolving_butchers_guard: Manifests a rotating wheel around the cultivator that protects the cultivator.
ascension.skill.rigid_stance_breathing.d: Root the feet, slow the breath, and cultivate while holding the body's structure against imagined pressure.
ascension.skill.rooted_grip.desc: A low, settled stance makes the body harder to shift and slightly softens incoming blows.
ascension.skill.rooted_grip.name: Rooted Grip
ascension.skill.sagittarius_heaven_pierc: Condense a homing spectral arrow who grows with charge.
ascension.skill.samsaras_witness.desc: The burdens witnessed along the six roads settle into an clarity of soul and body
ascension.skill.samsaras_witness.name: Samsara's Witness
ascension.skill.scorpius_star_nail_forma: Plant three stellar anchors around a chosen point.
ascension.skill.sevenfold_celestial_hunt: Project Ursa Major into the battlefield, creating a seven-node domain.
ascension.skill.shadowless_step.desc: Push essence through the legs in a single pulse and cross the ground before the trailing shadow seems to catch up.
ascension.skill.shadowless_step.name: Shadowless Step
ascension.skill.sheathed_edge.desc: Long practice at the draw sharpens ordinary sword attacks with a small but constant edge.
ascension.skill.sheathed_edge.name: Sheathed Edge
ascension.skill.skimming_stride.desc: Habitual lightness training makes every ordinary movement quicker and less burdened.
ascension.skill.skimming_stride.name: Skimming Stride
ascension.skill.slaughter_wheel_manifest: Launches a spinning essence wheel that bores through multiple enemies.
ascension.skill.stillfrost_breathing.des: Breathe slowly and draw frost into the soul, cultivating inner stillness while refining Soul through Ice
ascension.skill.summated_guard.desc: Layered stance principles reduce incoming force and make the body increasingly difficult to stagger.
ascension.skill.summated_guard.name: Summated Guard
ascension.skill.sustained_spirit.desc: Cold spiritual stillness suppresses wasteful movement, reducing exhaustion and stamina spent through travel
ascension.skill.sustained_spirit.name: Sustained Spirit
ascension.skill.sword_draw_meditation.de: Cultivate the sword while it remains sheathed, binding breath and intent to the moment before the draw.
ascension.skill.tempered_knuckles.desc: Hardened hands transfer more force through unarmed and fist-weapon attacks.
ascension.skill.tempered_knuckles.name: Tempered Knuckles
ascension.skill.transcendent_body_shockw: Stamp and release the body's gathered force outward, battering every nearby opponent with a physical shockwave.
ascension.skill.transcendent_impact.desc: Release the force gathered through the refined frame in one short, direct body strike.
ascension.skill.transcendent_impact.name: Transcendent Impact
ascension.skill.truth_seeking_channels.d: Repeated refinement steadies the essence channels, strengthening both spiritual clarity and bodily endurance.
ascension.skill.unending_revolution.desc: The internal wheel never truly stills.
ascension.skill.unending_revolution.name: Unending Revolution
ascension.skill.unseen_circulation.desc: A quiet, economical circulation keeps the body light and the spirit alert even outside deliberate movement.
ascension.skill.unseen_circulation.name: Unseen Circulation
ascension.technique.burning_bones_techni: A profound body technique that kindles fire within the marrow and uses the heat to temper bone from the inside out.
ascension.technique.celestial_constellat: A soul inheritance that maps the night sky within the spirit and expresses its constellations through celestial archery
ascension.technique.eagle_claw_palm_tech: A body art modeled on the hooked talons of mountain eagles, conditioning grip, forearms, and striking lines for sudden tearing palms.
ascension.technique.grasping_sand_techni: An ordinary palm art built around rooted footing and crushing hand control, training the practitioner to seize what would normally slip through the fingers.
ascension.technique.guardian_dharma_manu: A guardian manual that orders soul, life, and fist into endurance and a projected Dharma
ascension.technique.imperial_seven_stanc: Seven practical sword stances drilled into the mortal armies of the Yonmeng Empire; modest alone, dependable in formation.
ascension.technique.iron_fist_tempering_: A rough body-tempering manual that hardens knuckles, wrists, and forearms through repeated circulation and impact until the hands strike with the weight of iron.
A common body art of weight transfer and explosive footwork, allowing short bursts of speed and daring leaps.
ascension.technique.locust_bleeding_manu: A cruel essence manual that nests blood-feeding locust qi inside a victim and lets the weakening swarm seek nearby flesh.
ascension.technique.martial_transcendenc: The first volume of a progressive body scripture, stripping weakness from the mortal frame and establishing the foundation required for transcendence.
The second volume rebuilds the refined mortal frame under harsher circulation, forcing bone, blood, and tendon to resonate as one body.
The third volume carries the martial body beyond mere refinement, making flesh, bone, breath, and will act as a single heaven-defying weapon.
ascension.technique.mount_hua_sword_manu: A sword manual of Mount Hua that binds breath and sword as one, its gentle, falling-petal forms hiding a killing edge just a heartbeat behind
An eccentric essence scripture that seeks truth through refinements of the first realm, widening the same foundation again and again rather than rushing forward.
ascension.technique.nine_revolutions_sla: Carve nine interlocking revolutions into the essence sea, condensing a slaughter wheel that grows with each cycle.
ascension.technique.reapers_calling.desc: Walk beside death, understand the burdens of the fallen, and guide each departing soul toward the turning river of samsara
ascension.technique.reapers_calling.name: Reaper's Calling
ascension.technique.rigid_stance_summati: A profound defensive body art that collects dozens of bracing principles into one immovable stance, turning endurance and structure into a shield.
ascension.technique.shadowless_art.desc: A qigong essence art that threads qi through each step until motion seems to outrun its own shadow.
ascension.technique.shadowless_art.name: Shadowless Art
ascension.technique.slaughter_wheel_batt: A combat scripture that teaches applications of the Slaughter Wheel.
ascension.technique.sustained_spirit_art: An ordinary soul art that draws cold spiritual energy inward, quieting needless bodily activity to preserve nourishment and endurance
ascension.technique.sword_draw_manual.de: A plain sword manual devoted to the instant between stillness and steel, cultivating the sword through a single decisive draw.
